page_title: TOU 1-2 MNT | Toulouse v Montpellier 03/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
90+9' Referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+7' PENALTY APPEAL by Montpellier, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+5' Michel Der Zakarian is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kiki Kouyate suffers an injury and Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) comes on.
90+4' Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+4' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
90+3' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
90+2' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90+1' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marc Bollengier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
89' One of the Toulouse players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
87' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
86' Logan Costa (Toulouse) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.

83' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Marc Bollengier shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
81' 1 - 2 Goal! Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
81' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) replaces Vincent Sierro.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) replaces Cristian Casseres.
80' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
79' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Toulouse will take a corner kick.
78' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
77' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Marc Bollengier signals a set piece.
75' The corner from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is cleared away by the defence.
75' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
73' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
72' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moussa Diarra departs the field of play to be replaced by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch so that Leo Leroy can be given a rest.
68' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) replacing Akor Adams.
67' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Teji Savanier (Montpellier): it’s upheld, he has to go!
66' Referee Marc Bollengier is going to consult VAR for a possible red card infringement after that scuffle between the two teams, as it’s not immediately clear who the culprit was.

65' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
63' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
62' Substitution. Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) replaces Zakaria Aboukhlal.
62' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Mikkel Desler and he is replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
61' Akor Adams (Montpellier) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
60' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
60' Akor Adams (Montpellier) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
59' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) has a goal ruled out for offside!
54' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' Here is a change. Mousa Al-Tamari is going off and Michel Der Zakarian gives the last tactical orders to Yann Karamoh (Montpellier).
52' A player from Toulouse commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
52' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
51' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Toulouse.
51' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
50' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
49' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' The game is interrupted now, Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
47' The ball is crossed into the box and Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the left side of the goal, but Guillaume Restes gets a glove on it to thwart him.
46' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
46' The whistle blows and Marc Bollengier starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Dimitry Bertaud pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
45' Toulouse take a short corner kick.

45' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Dimitry Bertaud, who pulls off a stunning save! Corner kick. Toulouse will have an opportunity.
44' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' What was Leo Leroy (Montpellier) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
43' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
43' The game is interrupted. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
42' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Toulouse due to a foul in the build-up play.
40' The Toulouse players halt their celebrations as referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

40' An amazing individual effort from Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 2:1. Dimitry Bertaud was helpless.
39' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier).
39' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

39' A great individual effort by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) as he made a yard for himself and shot from the edge of the box. His attempt went towards the right side of the goal, but Dimitry Bertaud made a sensational reflex save and punched the ball onto the post! The referee blows his whistle, Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
37' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) sends a long ball in, but Dimitry Bertaud comfortably gathers the ball.
34' 1 - 1 Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) finds some space inside the box and scores with a crashing header into the roof of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
33' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and it's Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' The linesman signals that Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
28' A short pass finds Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.

27' 0 - 1 0:1. Teji Savanier (Montpellier) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the top left corner of the net. What a finish that is! Guillaume Restes did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Issiaga Sylla provided the assistance.
26' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
23' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
22' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul after Joris Chotard (Montpellier) hacks down one of his opponents.
21' Referee Marc Bollengier signals NO PENALTY for Toulouse after a VAR review!
21' Referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
21' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Toulouse for a penalty. Play continues.
21' Great chance! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post.

21' What a chance! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) jumps and powers a precise header towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper makes a spectacular reflex save and the ball deflects off his gloves onto the crossbar.
20' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
18' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Toulouse earn a corner.
17' Logan Costa (Toulouse) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
17' Corner kick. Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is ready to send the ball into the box.

17' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
16' Half-chance! Leo Leroy (Montpellier) plays a pass into the box, but Guillaume Restes reacts well to snuff out the attack.
15' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) meets a cross inside the box, but Dimitry Bertaud wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
15' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
14' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Now Toulouse have a corner.
13' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
11' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
10' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
9' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) brings his opponent down. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
6' The referee blows his whistle as Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) was too aggressive in his challenge.
5' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
3' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Toulouse are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Toulouse will kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will referee today's match.
